column3: Do not accuse your coworker without having clear evidence. (在沒有明確證據的情況下，不要指控你的同事。)
The milk will spoil if you leave it out. (如果你把牛奶放在外面，它會變質。)
The construction of the new office building is finished. (新辦公大樓的建設已經完成了。)
Please continue with your presentation after the break. (休息後請繼續你的簡報。)
Our company has a great reputation for quality service. (我們公司在優質服務方面享有盛譽。)
I suspect that he is lying about his experience. (我懷疑他在工作經驗上撒謊。)
The judge will sentence the thief tomorrow morning. (法官將在明天早上對小偷進行宣判。)
The jury found the man guilty of the crime. (陪審團裁定該男子犯有此罪。)
We decided to outsource our customer service to save money. (我們決定將客戶服務外包以節省開支。)
Both parties signed the agreement this afternoon. (雙方都在今天下午簽署了協議。)
